Most signals are flat or negative; ETH's marginal long is fragile given negative alpha, high volatility, and stress conditions. ETC is especially unreliable: zero price, volatility, liquidity, and risk statistics make its long signal non-actionable. BCH is the weakest fundamental/liquidity profile, while DOGE, SOL, and LTC also merit reduced conviction.
